selection.method: Frozen purposive stratified selection. This is a diagnostic curator-selected sample, not a code-executable selector or probability sample. Reproduce the exact sample by using selected_job_ids_in_corpus_order as the frozen manifest against the retained snapshot identity and verifying each row’s stratum, source/job provenance, and baseline output. The manifest was assembled to cover: every conflict; all eleven baseline classified families; unknown_scope and unclassified unresolved titles with varied role heads, source kinds, source enablement and active/inactive states; clear out_of_scope controls; technical-word false-positive controls (recruiting, customer success, program management, product); and unresolved test, partner, sales-engineering, support, mobile and platform/specialty titles. The selection intentionally favors diagnostic contrasts and source/status diversity, so inclusion probabilities are unknown and no population estimate is valid.

Any description-duty evidence used by the full classifier is preserved as an exact bounded matched line; every full description has a SHA-256 input digest.
annotation.denominator_policy: Manual annotations do not alter the baseline/runtime denominator in this iteration. Under accepted R1, only a clear out_of_scope result is excluded. decision_required is annotation vocabulary for unresolved cases, maps to the included unresolved group, and is not a production status.
